info.title: zxvd JSON-RPC
info.description: zxvd-rpc/1: JSON-RPC 2.0, one request per line over a 0600 UNIX socket owned by the same user (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_rpc.h). Errors: -32700 parse, -32600 invalid request or batch, -32601 unknown method, -32602 bad params, -32603 internal, -32000 libzxv status: error.data = {status: ZXV_E_* number, name: its symbolic name, class: USAGE|REFUSED|FATAL|SYSTEM}, -32010 peer request refused or failed (message says why), -32011 AIPI call refused or failed (message: the AIPI_ERR_* name and what it means), -32012 a module method (freight.*, harmonic.*, stream.*, ehop.*, web4.*) refused well-formed input: too few rows, a hash or AEAD tag that does not verify (message says why; zxvd_rpc_modules.h). Bytes travel as hex strings (*_hex). 64-bit integers (entry ids, *_minor results) travel as decimal strings. zxvd refuses to start against libzxv older than ABI 1.3.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: The protocol name and every method name this zxvd serves.

methods.name: zxvd.version
methods.summary: App version, protocol and the libzxv ABI version and feature mask.

methods.name: zxvd.shutdown
methods.summary: Stop the daemon after this reply; the socket file is removed.

methods.name: swarm.state
methods.summary: The live swarm: hardware budget, levels, cycles, market, settlement spine (pay_ledger postings, fees, halt), audit, quest, companion budget and last answer tag, network and update status. Same object as the window's /api/state.

methods.name: swarm.ask
methods.summary: Ask the companion. With a model installed it answers under the tokens-per-cycle budget gate and the answer is tagged; with none, shorthand is read back.

methods.name: model.info
methods.summary: The model slot: loaded, can_generate, name, arch, n_layers, n_vocab and one status line.

methods.name: notes.list
methods.summary: Recent notifications and the unread count.

methods.name: notes.mark_read
methods.summary: Mark every notification read.

methods.name: net.command
methods.summary: Vinea peer network: off, lan, online, peer IP:PORT, share C S, want RES UNITS MAX, sell RES UNITS PRICE NODEID. Off by default.

methods.name: net.peers
methods.summary: The routing table's contacts (zxv_net_host.h U9, zxvd_rpc.h V1). Every contact answered a signed message, so its NodeID is verified. Each row is joined with the peer's mesh-book account when there is one. Empty while networking is off.

addr.description: a.b.c.d:port, or "" for a non-IPv4 address

last_seen_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds of the last message

in_book.description: The mesh book has an account for it

member.description: Admitted to the commons by the owner

held.description: Units the peer issued that this node holds

receivable.description: Units delivered to the peer on credit

count.description: Contacts in the table (the list holds at most 256)

methods.name: net.offers
methods.summary: What the owner shares, the open wants, and the receipts still waiting on the other side (zxvd_rpc.h V2): a sell offer the buyer has not accepted, or a buy the seller has not committed.

max_price.description: The most this node pays for one receipt

want.description: buy: the want slot it reserves from; -1 for sell

methods.name: player.card
methods.summary: The owner's Player Card (sicily.h S2/S3, zxvd_rpc.h V3): the tier the measured inputs earn, each input with its source, the next tier's thresholds and which are missing, and the perks. Bond, uptime and giving have no source on this node yet and are reported as 0 with the reason. Tiers give no priority, discount or credit.

methods.name: peer.ask
methods.summary: Ask another node (found over UDP, then a TCP session: X25519 + ML-KEM-1024 key exchange, ML-DSA-87 on both sides) and pay its price plus the 0.08889% assurance fee from the peer wallet (kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_peer_host.h). Needs networking on. The daemon's loop waits while the request runs.

params.name: max_price_minor
params.description: the most this node will pay, VFV minor units, before the fee

methods.name: peer.serve
methods.summary: Start answering other nodes over TCP for price_minor VFV minor units per answer, or stop when price_minor is absent. Off by default; needs networking on.

params.name: price_minor
params.description: VFV minor units per answer; absent stops serving

methods.name: peer.status
methods.summary: The peer book: wallet, fee buckets, sales, purchases, the last 16 settlements, and whether the book verifies.

methods.name: update.check
methods.summary: Run one signed update check now (the only check while not online).

methods.name: currency.enable
methods.summary: Enable an ISO 4217 currency in the owner's books (libzxv zxv_ccy_enable_cap).

methods.name: ledger.open_account
methods.summary: Open an account (libzxv zxv_ledger_open_account_cap).

params.name: kind
params.description: holder (default; never below zero) or issuer

methods.name: ledger.post
methods.summary: Post a balanced transfer in minor units (libzxv zxv_ledger_post_cap). Amounts must be integers; fractions are refused, never rounded.

params.name: amount_minor
params.description: > 0 and at most 2^53-1 (libzxv ZXV_AMOUNT_MAX): a JSON integer or a decimal string

methods.name: ledger.balance
methods.summary: Rail balances of an account: DEBIT 555, CREDIT 777, EQUITY 888, in minor units.

methods.name: ledger.accounts
methods.summary: Every account with its name, currency and kind.

methods.name: ledger.entries
methods.summary: One account's journal, oldest first.

methods.name: ledger.check
methods.summary: Verify the books: per currency debits equal credits, no holder below zero, exact shadow equals the triple ledger. A failure poisons the context.

methods.name: swarm.earnings
methods.summary: The swarm's earnings in the owner's books (docs/ZXVD.md, zxvd_rpc.h E1-E5). After every settled market cycle the owner's account is set to the Financial capital (SWC) the owner's models hold, times rate_minor, by one balanced posting from or to the swarm market account. The accounts are null until the first settled cycle. With a books file (--books), accounts brought back at start keep their balance: the run's first cycle is the base and later cycles post only the change (E5).

currency.description: Earnings currency (default VFV, a private unit with 2 minor units; --earnings-ccy)

rate_minor.description: Minor units per SWC (--earnings-rate); a bookkeeping rate, not a market price

resumed.description: The accounts came back from the books file (E5)

methods.name: mesh.books
methods.summary: Settled peer requests in the owner's books (zxvd_rpc.h S1-S4): sales, purchases and the 0.08889% fee the node paid, in VFV, with the demo float posted as 'mesh float' when a purchase needs more than the wallet account holds. The accounts are null until the first settled request.

methods.name: books.file
methods.summary: Where the owner's books are saved (zxvd_rpc.h F1-F6): an append-only file of SHA-256-chained records, replayed at start. saved is false when the books live in memory only (no --books).

saved.description: A books file is in use

head.description: SHA-256 chain head after the last record

writable.description: False after a failed write: the books are read-only until zxvd restarts (F5)

methods.name: jurisdiction.get
methods.summary: The jurisdiction bridge's settings (zxvd_rpc.h J1-J5), kept in the books file.

market.description: J2: closed clearing (default) or the open batch-auction market

standard.description: J3: the accounting standard reports will follow; "" = not chosen

in_effect.description: J5: recorded only; no report adapter or open market is wired to the settings yet

methods.name: jurisdiction.set
methods.summary: Change any of market, standard and country (J4); the others keep their values. The change is saved in the books file before it applies; an unchanged setting writes nothing.

schema.description: J2: closed clearing (default) or the open batch-auction market
J3: the accounting standard reports will follow; "" = not chosen

market.description: J2: closed clearing (default) or the open batch-auction market

standard.description: J3: the accounting standard reports will follow; "" = not chosen

in_effect.description: J5: recorded only; no report adapter or open market is wired to the settings yet

methods.name: aipi.put
methods.summary: Store bytes (a Z-Wasm module, Z-Contract text, data) in this node's in-memory blockstore as a raw block, pinned; returns its CID. Give exactly one of hex and path (a file zxvd reads, at most 1 MiB). Offline node: nothing is announced (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_aipi.h Z1-Z2).

params.name: hex
params.description: the bytes as hex, at most 8000 bytes

params.name: path
params.description: a file to read instead of hex

params.name: private
params.description: seal the block at rest with this node's key (default false)

methods.name: aipi.get
methods.summary: AIPI_GET: the bytes a CID names, from the local blockstore, re-hashed before they are returned. At most 65536 bytes; a larger block is refused, not cut (Z4).

methods.name: aipi.publish
methods.summary: Publish a function descriptor (intent fn) and return its function CID. The rules of docs/AIPI.md section 3 apply: checker and cert need a checker export, cert a certifier, quorum is for the mesh only.

params.name: contract
params.description: CID of the Z-Contract text the calls must keep

params.name: fuel_max
params.description: most fuel one run may use (> 0)

params.name: local_only
params.description: privacy LOCAL: the descriptor is stored sealed and the function never leaves this node (default false)

params.name: deterministic
params.description: the same input always gives the same output (default true); only deterministic public calls are memoised

methods.name: aipi.execute
methods.summary: AIPI_EXECUTE on this node: run a published function in the Z-Wasm sandbox under its contract and fuel_max, or answer from the memo of earlier results (route cache). Offline (A3): code that is not in the local blockstore fails with AIPI_ERR_OFFLINE.

params.name: args
params.description: the Z-Wasm call ABI: up to 8 signed 64-bit integers

params.name: private
params.description: the input is private: never memoised (default false)

methods.name: aipi.status
methods.summary: The AIPI node: offline, blockstore use, call counts and the sandbox's counters.

methods.name: freight.pack
methods.summary: Erasure-code bytes into one freight (kernel/src/freight): 168 UBH-168 smart packets of 21 bytes, rows 0..k-1 the data and the rest Cauchy Reed-Solomon parity over GF(2^8), so ANY k of the 168 packets rebuild it. The 64-byte header carries the payload SHA-256 and travels separately. Holographic recovery here means erasure coding, nothing more.

params.name: data_hex
params.description: the payload, at most 3360 bytes (k = 168 x 20)

params.name: k
params.description: data rows (default: the fewest that hold the payload, so the most parity)

params.name: freight_id
params.description: 64-bit id (default: the first 8 bytes, little-endian, of the payload SHA-256)

packets_hex.description: 168 packets: byte 0 the row index, 1..20 payload
packets_hex.name: chat.me
packets_hex.summary: The owner's chat identity (zxvd_chat.h C1, C3, C7): the NodeID (SHA-256 of the ML-DSA-65 key), whether records are saved beside the books, how many are held, and who the owner follows.

packets_hex.name: freight.unpack
packets_hex.summary: Rebuild a freight from any k of its packets (any order; duplicates and unknown rows ignored) and check the payload SHA-256. Fewer than k distinct rows, a corrupted row or a malformed header is -32012.

schema.name: chat.post
schema.summary: Sign and save a public post, or a reply when reply_to names a held record (C5, C6). Text is 1..1024 bytes of UTF-8 with something besides spaces. Records stay on this device: there is no exchange with peers yet.

schema.description: the id of a held record to reply to

schema.name: harmonic.encode
schema.summary: Pack one UBH-168 harmonic wire frame (kernel/src/harmonic/zt_harmonic_wire.h W1-W3): a tag octet (100 x sync + 10 x shell + trunk) and five 32-bit words in fixed little/big/little/big/little byte order, S+ rail in W0, W2, W4 and S- rail in W1, W3. Line coding: the pattern is public and carries no secret.

params.name: s_plus
params.description: the S+ (I) rail: three words, signed Q16.16 or raw 32-bit

properties.name: harmonic.decode
properties.summary: Unpack a 21-octet frame and resolve it with the stateless correlation resolver (W5): UNKNOWN (all zero), NEUTRAL (idle pilot or a silent rail), TRUE, FALSE or GLUT. A stateless resolver never returns PARADOX (W7).

params.name: threshold_q16
params.description: correlation threshold, Q16.16 (default 4096, the endian mux's 1/16)

schema.name: chat.react
schema.summary: Sign and save a reaction (an emoji or a word, 1..32 bytes of UTF-8) to a held record (C5, C6).

schema.description: the id of a held record

schema.name: stream.plan
schema.summary: Cut recorded media units into segments with the live cutter's rule (kernel/src/stream stream_vod_plan): a segment closes before the first keyframe at least target_us after its start, or before any unit once max_us have passed or max_bytes would be exceeded. Units are contiguous from offset 0.

params.name: units
params.description: at most 120 units, each [len, pts_us, keyframe]; pts_us must not go backwards

segments.name: stream.segment
segments.summary: Describe one swarm-stream segment (kernel/src/stream stream_manifest_build): its IPFS CIDv1 (raw, sha2-256), the freight id derived from it and the SHA-256 of each freight that carries it. The signed manifest itself needs a signing key and is not produced here.

schema.name: chat.follow
schema.summary: Follow or unfollow a NodeID (C7). The newest FOLLOW record decides; a repeat of the current state writes nothing.

properties.name: ehop.bands
properties.summary: The Endian Hopping band plan (kernel/src/ehop/ehop.h): the FM, AM and PM ranges, priority, largest frame and target latency of each band.

bands.name: chat.feed
bands.summary: The held posts, best first, at most 50, ranked by what each adds over the others (social_feed.h F2-F5, the Interaction Surplus Framework) with a small freshness term. No likes, reply counts or views are read by the ranker.

result.name: ehop.seal
result.summary: Seal one frame on an Endian Hopping channel: the keyed byte-order schedule, then ChaCha20-Poly1305. Confidentiality and integrity come from the AEAD alone. zxvd keeps no channel state: the caller owns the nonce discipline and must never seal two plaintexts with the same key, channel, configuration, sender and seq.

params.name: key_hex
params.description: the 32-byte channel secret (a pairwise ML-KEM shared secret, or a private network key)

params.name: am_mask
params.description: AM: allowed reordering depths, a subset of the band's (default: all the band allows)

params.name: pm_mode
params.description: PM: 0 static, 1 per epoch, 2 per frame (default 0)

params.name: fm_rate
params.description: FM: mean words per flip, inside the band (default the band's fm_min)

params.name: sender
params.description: this sealer's sender id, unique on the channel

params.name: seq
params.description: sequence number, never reused; 2^64 - 1 is refused

params.name: plaintext_hex
params.description: at most 2048 bytes, and within the band's largest frame

schema.name: chat.thread
schema.summary: A held record and its replies in (Lamport, id) order (C5).

schema.description: the id of a held record

schema.name: ehop.open
schema.summary: Open one frame: format, epoch, channel tag and AEAD are checked and the schedule is undone. A frame for another key, configuration or epoch, or a changed byte, is -32012. zxvd keeps no replay window: the caller tracks (sender, seq).

params.name: key_hex
params.description: the 32-byte channel secret (a pairwise ML-KEM shared secret, or a private network key)

params.name: am_mask
params.description: AM: allowed reordering depths, a subset of the band's (default: all the band allows)

params.name: pm_mode
params.description: PM: 0 static, 1 per epoch, 2 per frame (default 0)

params.name: fm_rate
params.description: FM: mean words per flip, inside the band (default the band's fm_min)

schema.name: web4.cid
schema.summary: Content addressing (kernel/src/web4 on kernel/src/ipfs_node): the CIDv1 (raw, sha2-256) of bytes, or the forms of a given CID: its string, its ipfs:// URI and the 32-byte digest an EVM contract can store (null unless sha2-256). Give exactly one of data_hex and cid.

params.name: cid
params.description: a CID or an ipfs:// URI

schema.name: web4.agent_card
schema.summary: Make a self-bound Web 4 agent card (kernel/src/web4/web4_agent.h A1-A3) from a 32-byte key seed: the ML-DSA-65 key pair, agent_id = SHA3-256(public key), and the binding signed deterministically. zxvd wipes the secret key before it answers and keeps nothing; the seed is the agent's secret.

agent_id.description: SHA3-256 of the ML-DSA-65 public key

peer_id.description: equal to agent_id: the card is self-bound

bind_sig_hex.description: ML-DSA-65 signature (3309 bytes) over the binding, context web4/v1/agent-bind

schema.name: web4.card_verify
schema.summary: Verify a self-bound agent card: agent_id is the key's SHA3-256 and the binding signature verifies. A card that does not verify is a result with valid false and the reason, not an error.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: an agent_id to check against the key
